import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int dim, limit;
    static int[][] capacity;
    static List<List<Integer>> adj;
    static int[] dist;
    static int[] p;

    static boolean bfs(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        dist[source] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v : adj.get(u)) {
                if (dist[v] == -1 && capacity[u][v] > 0) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int sink, int flow) {
        if (u == sink) return flow;
        for (int i = p[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
            p[u] = i;
            int v = adj.get(u).get(i);
            if (dist[v] == dist[u] + 1 && capacity[u][v] > 0) {
                int f = dfs(v, sink, Math.min(flow, capacity[u][v]));
                if (f > 0) {
                    capacity[u][v] -= f;
                    capacity[v][u] += f;
                    return f;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic(int source, int sink) {
        int total = 0;
        while (bfs(source, sink)) {
            Arrays.fill(p, 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs(source, sink, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                total += f;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        dim = sc.nextInt();
        limit = sc.nextInt();
        
        int total_nodes = 2 * dim * dim + 2;
        capacity = new int[total_nodes][total_nodes];
        adj = new ArrayList<>(total_nodes);
        for (int i = 0; i < total_nodes; i++) {
            adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        dist = new int[total_nodes];
        p = new int[total_nodes];
        
        String[] sci = new String[dim];
        String[] cap = new String[dim];
        
        int[][][] vert = new int[dim][dim][2];
        int bad_pos = -1;
        
        int next = 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
            sci[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {
                if (sci[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && sci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    int node = next++;
                    capacity[0][node] = sci[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    adj.get(0).add(node);
                    adj.get(node).add(0);
                    vert[i][j][0] = node;
                } else if (sci[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    bad_pos = 100 * i + j;
                    sci[i] = sci[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + sci[i].substring(j + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int max_node = next;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
            cap[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {
                if (cap[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && cap[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    int node = max_node++;
                    capacity[node][1] = cap[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    adj.get(node).add(1);
                    vert[i][j][1] = node;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int[][] bad_dist = new int[dim][dim];
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(bad_dist[i], limit + 1);
        if (bad_pos != -1) {
            bad_dist[bad_pos / 100][bad_pos % 100] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(bad_pos);
            int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
            int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int pos = q.poll();
                int x = pos / 100, y = pos % 100;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                    if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim &&
                        sci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && bad_dist[nx][ny] > bad_dist[x][y] + 1) {
                        bad_dist[nx][ny] = bad_dist[x][y] + 1;
                        q.offer(100 * nx + ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {
                if (sci[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && sci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    int[][] reach = new int[dim][dim];
                    for (int x = 0; x < dim; ++x)
                        Arrays.fill(reach[x], limit + 1);
                    reach[i][j] = 0;
                    
                    if (cap[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && cap[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                        int u = vert[i][j][0], v = vert[i][j][1];
                        capacity[u][v] = capacity[v][u] = Integer.MAX_VALUE - 1;
                        adj.get(u).add(v);
                        adj.get(v).add(u);
                    }
                    
                    Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
                    q.offer(100 * i + j);
                    int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
                    int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        int pos = q.poll();
                        int x = pos / 100, y = pos % 100;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                            int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim &&
                                sci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && reach[nx][ny] > reach[x][y] + 1) {
                                if (cap[nx].charAt(ny) >= '1' && cap[nx].charAt(ny) <= '9') {
                                    if (reach[x][y] + 1 <= bad_dist[nx][ny]) {
                                        int src = vert[i][j][0];
                                        int dst = vert[nx][ny][1];
                                        capacity[src][dst] = Integer.MAX_VALUE - 1;
                                        adj.get(src).add(dst);
                                        adj.get(dst).add(src);
                                    }
                                }
                                if (reach[x][y] + 1 < bad_dist[nx][ny]) {
                                    reach[nx][ny] = reach[x][y] + 1;
                                    q.offer(100 * nx + ny);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(dinic(0, 1));
    }
}
